samples.gvd:
module JC_counter (
    input                clk,
    input                rst_n,
    output reg [63:0]     Q
);
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        Q <= 64'b0;
    end else begin
        if (Q[0] == 1'b0) begin
            Q <= {Q[62:0], 1'b1};
        end else begin
            Q <= {Q[62:0], 1'b0};
        end
    end
end
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="JC_counter">
    <description>64-bit Johnson counter (torsional ring counter).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the counter.</input>
        <output id="Q" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit register representing the current count value.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <!-- No parameter description needed -->
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        reg [63:0] Q_reg;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                Q_reg <= 64'b0;
            end else begin
                if (Q_reg[0] == 1'b0) begin
                    Q_reg <= {Q_reg[62:0], 1'b1};
                end else begin
                    Q_reg <= {Q_reg[62:0], 1'b0};
                end
            end
        end
        assign Q = Q_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
